description: Send the website change frozen by prepare_website_edit to SiteMe, which applies it to the live site at once; it can be undone with prepare_undo_website_edit and confirm_undo_website_edit. Returns applied, consequence, url to check and last_changed on success; can take up to two minutes. Requires company:write and the same sign-in's unused intent, valid for ten minutes. Obtain approval for the exact consequence first.
name: confirm_website_edit
title: Confirm a website edit
